pages.title: Elephant Task Force to curb human-elephant conflict

facts.text: Formed by: AP PCCF and Head of Forest Force (HoFF), under guidance of Deputy CM K. Pawan Kalyan
facts.head: News

facts.text: Led by: P. Vivek, DFO Tirupati; members include S. Bharani, DFO Chittoor
facts.head: News

facts.text: Aim: 24x7 monitoring of elephant movements; real-time alerts to fringe villages
facts.head: News

facts.text: Coordination: Revenue, Electricity, Panchayat Raj depts; rescue with SV Zoo Park vets and Nanniyala Elephant Camp
facts.head: News

facts.text: Expert: wildlife biologist Rakesh Kalva, NGO FREE WILD
facts.head: News

facts.text: Spearheaded by: Conservator of Forests (FAC) C. Selvam
facts.head: News

pages.title: Sea slug Phidiana unilineata rediscovered off Visakhapatnam after 160 years

facts.text: Species: Phidiana unilineata — a nudibranch (soft-bodied marine gastropod mollusc)
facts.head: News

facts.text: When: City Nature Challenge 2025 (April) — global citizen science initiative
facts.head: News

facts.text: Found by: Sri Chakra Pranav, founder, East Coast Conservation Team (ECCT)
facts.head: News

facts.text: First recorded: 1864, from Visakhapatnam, by British zoologists Joshua Alder and Albany Hancock
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ No sighting since 1864 — possible endemic to Visakhapatnam coast (rocky shores, hydroids)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Alder and Hancock recorded over 20 sea slug species from Visakhapatnam in the 19th century
facts.head: News

facts.text: Indicator: sea slugs indicate healthy marine ecosystems (depend on corals, hydroids)
facts.head: News

pages.title: Karnataka hands over kumki elephants to AP

facts.text: What: Karnataka gave four kumki elephants to AP; two more to follow
facts.head: News

facts.text: From: Dubare Elephant Camp, Kodagu (35 elephants)
facts.head: News

facts.text: To: special forest camp in Chittoor district — conflict areas Kuppam and Palakundalam
facts.head: News

facts.text: MoU: after talks between Karnataka Forest Minister Eshwar B. Khandre and AP Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan (Aug–Sept 2023); AP to report on elephants' welfare
facts.head: News

facts.text: Training: 25 AP mahouts trained in Karnataka two months earlier; handlers are mahouts and kawadis
facts.head: News

facts.text: Kumki: trained captive elephants used to drive away/capture wild elephants
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Karnataka has over 100 trained elephants; since 2016 gave over 65 to Uttarakhand, Jharkhand, UP, MP, Bihar, Maharashtra
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ First Karnataka inter-state transfer after a two-year gap; Maharashtra was the previous recipient
facts.head: Background

pages.title: Large forest fires decline 21.83% in AP

facts.text: Decline: 21.83% in large forest fires, 1 January–18 May 2025 vs 2024 — 874 vs 1,118
facts.head: News

facts.text: Fire alerts 2025: 12,037 (SNPP and MODIS); AP 4th after Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand
facts.head: News

facts.text: Large forest fires, full 2024: Uttarakhand; Count: 1,282 (highest)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Large forest fires, full 2024: Andhra Pradesh; Count: 1,135
facts.head: News

facts.text: Large forest fires, full 2024: Odisha; Count: 1,128
facts.head: News

facts.text: Forest Survey of India (FSI) tracks large fires using SNPP (Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership) and MODIS
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Measures: fire lines, view lines, awareness
facts.head: Background

pages.title: Artificial reefs off Jalari Yendada, Visakhapatnam

facts.text: Launched: 20 May 2025 by Fisheries Minister Kinjarapu Atchannaidu; with seaweed harvest programme
facts.head: News

facts.text: Phase I: 22 artificial reef units in North Andhra waters; concrete shapes (triangles, flowers, pipes)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Funding: 60% Centre, 40% State under PMMSY
facts.head: News

facts.text: Distance: within 2.5 km of shore — fuel cost cut up to 80%
facts.head: News

facts.text: Target species: kingfish, tuna, red snapper, prawns, crabs, squids, octopuses
facts.head: News

facts.text: Project leader: Dr Joe Kizhakudan, Principal Scientist, CMFRI
facts.head: News

facts.text: Also: 634 transponders for mechanised boats
facts.head: News

facts.text: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: launched 2020; Blue Economy; SDG-14 (Life Below Water)
facts.head: Background — PMMSY
